_comment: ACP agent launch configs. Commands/versions come from the ACP registry (registry-main/<id>/agent.json). skill_dir is where THAT agent looks for project skills relative to the session cwd (workspace/) — this is the per-harness 'mounting glue' that differs even though the SKILL.md itself is identical. `install` + `configure` declare how the desktop UI bootstraps each agent (Install/Configure buttons on the harness card). `probe` declares how `scan_harnesses` detects whether the agent is really present on THIS machine: `bin` is the vendor CLI the user signs in with (NOT `npx`, which is always present and proves nothing — the ACP adapter package itself is fetched lazily by npx at launch). `bin_env_key` lets a power user pin an explicit path (e.g. CLAUDE_BIN). When `probe` is omitted, detection falls back to the launch `command` (correct for ./var/bin binaries).

claude.name: Claude Code (claude-acp)
claude.auth: Run `claude login` first (Pro/Max), or set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. The agent handles its own auth (ACP 'Agent Auth').

codex.name: Codex CLI (codex-acp)
codex.auth: Run `codex login` first (ChatGPT/Codex subscription), or set OPENAI_API_KEY.

gemini.name: Gemini CLI (gemini)
gemini.auth: Google login via the gemini CLI (free tier) or GEMINI_API_KEY. The agent handles its own auth.

qwen.name: Qwen Code (qwen-code)
qwen.auth: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY in .env (Qwen OAuth free tier ended Apr 15 2026). Gemini-CLI fork; native --experimental-skills.
qwen.note: Qwen brain — pairs with your local Ollama qwen3.5.

opencode.name: OpenCode (model-agnostic)
opencode.auth: Model-agnostic (75+ providers incl. local). For a zero-key local brain, configure an Ollama provider (http://localhost:11434/v1). Cloud providers via `opencode auth login`.

copilot.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
copilot.auth: GitHub Copilot subscription (gh auth login with Copilot enabled) or GH_TOKEN.

mistral-vibe.name: Mistral Vibe (vibe-acp)
mistral-vibe.auth: Set MISTRAL_API_KEY (cloud). Download the vibe-acp binary into var/bin/ first — see README.
mistral-vibe.note: No npx distribution; ships as a platform binary. Vibe scans its own `.vibe/` config dir for skills + agent instructions, so `skill_dir = .vibe/skills` and `install_persona` also projects the persona into `<ws>/.vibe/AGENTS.md` (in addition to the universal `<ws>/AGENTS.md`). See split/core.py:install_persona.

hermes.name: Hermes (NousResearch, model-agnostic)
hermes.auth: Configure via `hermes auth` (OAuth device-code) or edit ~/.hermes/config.yaml. Model-agnostic on 19+ providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp, LM Studio…). `hermes proxy` can also expose Claude Pro/ChatGPT Pro/SuperGrok OAuth subscriptions as a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
hermes.note: From NousResearch (github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent). The official installer also provisions Python 3.11 (via uv, no sudo), Node 22 (for browser automation + WhatsApp bridge), ripgrep and ffmpeg. Binary lands in ~/.local/bin/hermes.
